title: Guide new claimants through their first claim
body:
### Summary

Show new claimants a guided checklist for their first claim, to move Goal #20's activation.

### Hypothesis

If new claimants see a checklist of the documents to gather before they start, activation rises from 0.31 to 0.36 because they no longer abandon the claim to look for documents.

### Metric

activation

### Baseline

0.31: activation over the weekly cohorts of 2026-08-31 to 2026-09-28, from `aayu measure` snapshot all-20261005T060000Z.sqlite

### Target

>= 0.36 by 2026-12-31
